key_catalyst: Apple's 9.1% plunge on weak September-quarter guidance citing AI component supply constraints, partially offset by Amazon's blowout AWS results and semiconductor relief rally
reasoning: QQQ demonstrated remarkable resilience today, falling only 0.47% despite Apple's 9.1% plunge as the fund's largest weighting (~12%), because Amazon's 15.3% surge on reaccelerating AWS growth and an 8.19% Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rally—the strongest since April 2025—provided powerful offsetting lifts. The macro headwinds of rising yields (4.74%) and oil ($87.93) on Iran escalation are recurring themes the market has absorbed across multiple sessions (07-27 through 07-29), and the market's ability to rally +3.30% on 07-30 despite three hawkish Fed dissents shows underlying demand for tech at these levels.
